gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Warnes sprawls wide, with ink strokes that taper off before they touch. Anek Gurmukhi, a plain sans with large open counters and generous curves, makes extended reading feel unhurried and light.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-kannada: Rod-stiff and stretched out, Warnes keeps one stroke width from start to finish. Anek Kannada then stands tall beneath it, its high lowercase and far-reaching terminal gaps giving the sans-serif text a squared, modern footing.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-tamil: Wide, inky, and unhurried: Warnes draws every stroke like a rolling-ball pen. And Anek Tamil keeps text moving easily, its big round lowercase bowls giving each line a modern pace.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu leads with wide, tall bowls that set its reading rhythm, and its rounds stay unsealed like an unlatched hook. Text in it reads clean and approachable beneath Warnes, the bold display heading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-arimo: Straight-edged and stretched wide, Warnes draws bold, constant strokes that taper out before they ever touch, spaced generously. Arimo, with its tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps, sits tidily underneath.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-athiti: Loud ink and stretched spacing: that is Warnes. Athiti, cut like sign-shop vinyl with see-through s shapes and a high mean line, reads nicely at modest sizes beneath it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-duru-sans: Stretched-out swagger, with Warnes holding full thickness through every curve. Duru Sans then reads modern and clean, its wide openings and dominant bodies keeping the lines easy to follow.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-fresca: Expressive and stretched wide, Warnes lets ink strokes taper out before they touch. Fresca, a modern sans with no calligraphic thinning and short ascenders over big bowls, keeps text smooth and clean.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-georama: Approachable and unfussy, the text beneath Warnes has a c pulled apart like a bracelet and barely rising capitals. Georama keeps long reading steady and low-key while Warnes's monoline strokes do the shouting.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hind-guntur: Expressive and stretched, Warnes draws bold strokes that taper out before touching. And Hind Guntur, its lowercase tall like stamped metal type, can sit comfortably at modest sizes beneath it.
